why.lead: Professional massage without leaving your room. Your therapist comes to your home, condo or hotel, at any hour.

come.title: We Come to You
come.text: No traffic, no parking, no waiting room. Stay where you are and relax.

verified.title: Verified Therapists
verified.text: Every therapist’s ID is checked before they take bookings, and they always arrive in the EasyGoSpa uniform.

cash.title: Pay on Arrival
cash.text: Nothing to pay upfront. You pay your therapist in cash when they arrive.

why.imageAlt: The EasyGoSpa green bag, folded towels and a stoneware bowl on a bench at the foot of a bed at home

services.lead: Every treatment and price, listed. Choose your therapist when you book.

stats.lead: Professional massage at your hotel, condo or home across Metro Manila, with clear prices and nothing to pay until your therapist arrives.

journeys.lead: Choose how you feel, and we’ll show you the treatment for it.
journeys.hint: Hover to pause · Swipe to see more

items.relax: Long, flowing strokes with oil to help you unwind after a long day.
items.muscles: Slow, firm pressure on knots and tight spots in your back, neck and shoulders.
items.stretch: Assisted stretches and pressure on a floor mat, fully clothed and without oil.
items.pressure: Firm finger and palm pressure along the body, without oil.
items.warmth: Warm stones and smooth strokes to loosen tight muscles.
items.calm: Gentle strokes with soothing essential oils to quiet the mind.

included.lead: Every price is listed before you book. You pay your therapist in cash when they arrive, and tips are never expected.

standard.lead: EasyGo Spa provides professional home massage across Metro Manila. Our therapists travel directly to your hotel, condo or home, so you can relax in your own space.

verified.title: Verified Therapists
verified.text: Professionally trained and carefully screened therapists.

fast.title: Fast Arrival
fast.text: Quick therapist dispatch across Metro Manila.

private.title: Safe & Private
private.text: Enjoy your massage in your own hotel room, condo or home.

open.title: 24/7 Booking
open.text: Book your session any time, day or night.

areas.title: Serving Metro Manila, Day and Night

pay.a: In cash, to your therapist, when they arrive. Nothing is paid upfront and no deposit is needed.

tips.a: No. Tipping is never expected. Every treatment and price is listed on our pricing page.

where.a: To your home, condo or hotel room in our service areas across Metro Manila, day or night.

choose.a: Yes. When you book, you see each available therapist’s profile and choose who comes.

when.a: Any time, 24 hours a day. Book for right now, or choose a time for later.
